name: loader
title: Loader
blurb: Collection of 5 animated loader variants with different animation styles.
description: A collection of 5 animated loader components - bobbing dots, sliding dots, lightning animation, glitchy text, and wave text - each with unique continuous animations.
use_when: Showing loading states where you want visual variety, pick the animation style that fits your design.
avoid_when: When you need a simple, minimal loader without much animation.
a11y: Animations only, no inherent text labels (LoaderFour and LoaderFive can include optional text).
